Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
If Methuselah C attempts to remove Seeds of Corruption played by Methuselah A on a minion controlled by Methuselah B, it is an action directed at Methuselah B.

Is this correct?

Seeds of Corruption

+1 stealth action.
Put this card on one of your prey's vampires. If the vampire is a Follower of Set, he or she burns 2 additional blood when attempting an action; otherwise, he or she burns 1 additional blood when attempting an action. The vampire's special abilities cannot be used. Any vampire(s) may burn this card with two +1 stealth actions.
As above, but the vampire burns 2 additional blood when attempting an action; Followers of Set burn 3 additional blood.

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
Correct. It's a  action targeting the card and directed towards the controller of the vampire having the card.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Correct - minions cards on minions are controlled by controller of the minion they are on.
